title: HumanVLA Trajectory Exchange Schema
description: Frozen data exchange format between the Kinect 3D reference branch and the main RGB monocular branch. Each record is one joint in one frame.

video_id.description: Unique video identifier within the project, e.g. 'KVAL001', 'E001'.

frame_index.description: Zero-based frame index within the video.

source_frame_index.description: Original frame index from the source system, if different from frame_index.

joint_name.description: Joint identifier using BODY_25 naming convention.

u_rgb.description: Horizontal pixel coordinate in the RGB image. null if unavailable.

v_rgb.description: Vertical pixel coordinate in the RGB image. null if unavailable.

x_camera_m.description: 3D X coordinate in camera frame (right), in meters. null if unavailable.

y_camera_m.description: 3D Y coordinate in camera frame (down), in meters. null if unavailable.

z_camera_m.description: 3D Z coordinate in camera frame (forward / depth), in meters. null if unavailable.

x_2d_norm.description: Normalized 2D x coordinate (x_pixel / image_width), from monocular method. null if not applicable.

y_2d_norm.description: Normalized 2D y coordinate (y_pixel / image_height), from monocular method. null if not applicable.

x_25d_m.description: 2.5D X coordinate in task-aligned frame, in meters. null if not applicable.

y_25d_m.description: 2.5D Y coordinate in task-aligned frame, in meters. null if not applicable.

z_25d_m.description: 2.5D Z coordinate (height) in task-aligned frame, in meters. null if not applicable.

confidence.description: Joint confidence normalized to [0, 1]. For Kinect: 0=NONE, 0.33=LOW, 0.67=MEDIUM, 1.0=HIGH.

observation_valid.description: Whether the joint is actually observed (not hallucinated or inferred from far-away data).

reference_valid.description: Whether this record qualifies as a reliable reference measurement. Kinect joints with LOW/NONE confidence or bone-length anomalies are reference_valid=false.

reference_quality.description: Quality tier of the reference measurement.

invalid_reason.description: Reason why reference_valid is false, or 'none' if valid.

source.description: Origin of the trajectory data. kinect_reference = Azure Kinect 3D reference. rgb_raw = raw monocular 2D. rgb_refined = quality-optimized monocular 2D. task_constrained_25d = 2.5D task-constrained trajectory.

phase_label.description: Coarse action phase label for the frame.

camera_frame.description: Right-handed coordinate system. Origin at camera optical center.

rgb_image_frame.u_axis: Horizontal, 0 at left edge, increasing right
rgb_image_frame.v_axis: Vertical, 0 at top edge, increasing down

task_aligned_frame.description: Task-aligned 2.5D coordinate system. Origin at table center or task reference point A.
task_aligned_frame.y_axis: Horizontal, perpendicular to x in table plane

_usage_notes: This schema defines the FROZEN exchange format between branches.
Kinect branch produces records with source='kinect_reference'.
Main RGB branch produces records with source='rgb_raw', 'rgb_refined', or 'task_constrained_25d'.
For 2D comparison: match on (video_id, frame_index, joint_name), compare (u_rgb, v_rgb) from kinect_reference vs rgb_refined.

For 2.5D comparison: match on (video_id, frame_index, joint_name), compare (x_25d_m, y_25d_m, z_25d_m) from task_constrained_25d vs (x_camera_m, y_camera_m, z_camera_m) from kinect_reference after coordinate alignment.
Kinect measurements are pseudo-ground-truth, not absolute ground truth.
Always filter reference_valid=true before computing error statistics against reference.
Different recordings of the same task can only be compared on aggregate statistics (phase means, ranges, distributions), not frame-by-frame.
